$comment: Reviewed exemptions for the component→pattern-registry parity gate (#368). Each entry is a public PascalCase export from @sovereignsquad/gds-core or @sovereignsquad/gds-admin that is NOT a standalone catalog pattern: it is a layout/style primitive, typography atom, provider/context, formatter, template/catalog helper, chart sub-part, Admin/Partner sub-part of an already-registered pattern, icon surface, or a client-runtime composite whose canonical pattern is registered under a different sourceComponent. Genuine UI pattern components must be REGISTERED in apps/playground/src/pattern-registry.ts (as a sourceComponent), not exempted. Reviewed via diff. See docs/COMPONENT_CATALOG_PARITY.md.
